Technical SEO.title: Search News Buzz Video Recap: Google November Core Update Status, FBI Alert On SEO Poisoning, Bing & ChatGPT Web Only Links, Microsoft Ads Bid Upgrade
Technical SEO.summary: The Google November 2026 core update is still in progress, and the FBI issued an alert about SEO poisoning delivering malware. Google Search Console's Search Analytics API also received new additions covered in the recap.

Technical SEO.title: The .seo Top-Level Domain (TLD) May Be Coming Soon
Technical SEO.summary: A .seo generic top-level domain applied for by XYZ under ICANN's new gTLD round was confirmed on the final list following String Confirmation Day in October 2026, though it is not yet available for public registration.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Why Building Trust Through Real People Stands The Test Of Time In SEO & AI Search
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article argues that scaled AI content, fake authors, and self-promotional listicles are unreliable long-term strategies, and that leading with real human experts continues to pay off across both traditional search and AI search surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Citations: What To Check Before Reacting To A Lost One
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece outlines four diagnostic checks to perform before making page changes in response to a lost AI citation, noting that most citations that disappear tend to return on their own.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google's Top 10 Line For CMOs Points At Generic Tips Posts
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google's marketing account advised CMOs to move away from generic tips posts and replace them with content grounded in first-hand expertise, signaling a continued editorial direction that affects content strategy for enterprise sites.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Salesforce CEO Says Goodbye SEO. Salesforce's SEO Guide Disagrees
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff publicly declared SEO obsolete while promoting a product, while Salesforce's own published SEO guide contradicts that position by describing SEO as a foundational channel.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Disrupts Its Search Advertising with Its Embrace of A.I
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is reshaping its core search advertising model as it integrates AI more deeply into search, with implications for how organic and paid results compete for visibility on the results page.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google rolls out new search homepage with AI chat history and no search button
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has launched a redesigned search homepage that removes the traditional search button and adds an AI sidebar with chat history, representing a significant shift in the search interface that affects how users interact with results.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Officially Rolls Out Collapsible Sidebar on Search
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has begun a broad rollout of a collapsible AI mode sidebar on its search results pages, a structural change to the SERP layout that enterprise SEOs need to account for in visibility planning.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT citation drops look like unannounced Google core updates
AI Search / GEO.summary: Analysis from Search Engine Land draws parallels between sudden drops in ChatGPT citations and the unpredictable volatility pattern of unannounced Google core updates, raising new monitoring challenges for GEO practitioners.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google, ChatGPT & Others AI Engines Provide Coupon Codes
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and other AI engines are now surfacing merchant coupon and promo codes directly in their answers, reducing the need for users to visit dedicated coupon sites and creating a new zero-click dynamic for travel and retail brands.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Business Hub offers a glimpse of a search console for AI
AI Search / GEO.summary: ChatGPT's new Business Hub is described as an early analog to Google Search Console for publishers, potentially giving brands a first look at how their content is being indexed and cited within ChatGPT's search environment.
